GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 004.2 (31 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN-521)
APO 500
31 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Appointment of Bank of Japan as Fiscal Agent for Certain Institutions Closed pursuant to Memorandum of this Headquarters AG 091. 3 (30 Sept 45) ESS.
1. It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government appoint the Bank of Japan as Fiscal Agent for institutions closed pursuant to the subject referenced memorandum, pending the appointment of Liquidators for such institutions.
2. The Bank of Japan will be instructed to set up separate Fiscal Agency Accounts for and in the name, of each of the subject institutions, and to advance funds to, and to disburse funds from, such accounts as necessary to meet expenses of examination and other expenses approved by this Headquarters.
3. The assets and liabilities of these Fiscal Agency accounts will be assumed by the Liquidators of the institutions upon their subsequent appointment.
4. The Bank of Chosen, The Bank of Taiwan, Deutsche Bank fur Ostasien, Banque Franco-Japonaise, Chosen Colonization Bank and Banque de l’Indo-Chine are excepted from the provisions of this memorandum.
5. Direct communication between the Ministry of Finance, the Bank of Japan and interested Staff Sections of this Headquarters is hereby authorized to implement this memorandum.
6. It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government acknowledge receipt of this memorandum and furnish to this Headquarters three copies, in English and Japanese texts, of all ordinances issued to implement compliance with its provisions.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.Allen
Colonel,A.G.D.
Asst Adjutant General
